rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when emphasizing the thing itself rather than another participant.

example.english: The computer itself has no problem.
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 bun2 san1 mou5 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this as the reflexive object when the thing doing the action is also affected by it.

example.traditional: 個程式會自己刪除自己。
example.jyutping: go3 cing4 sik1 wui5 zi6 gei2 saan1 ceoi4 zi6 gei2
